column2: Provided, that the Commission shall grant an opportunity

column2: (1) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any

column1: other written law, the Commission may create cadre positions
and employ officers and servants as it considers necessary
for the efficient discharge of its functions and may fix their
salaries  and  wages  or  other  remuneration,  benefits  and
pensions of such servants and officers for the purposes of
carrying out its functions and duties under the provisions of
this Act.

column2: (2) The Commission may establish and regulate pension

column1: and  provident  funds  and  schemes  for  the  benefit  of  the
Director-General  and  its  officers  and  servants  and  their
dependents  and  nominees  with  the  concurrence  of  the
Minister  assigned  the  subject  of  finance  and  may  make
contributions to any such fund or scheme.

column2: (3)  The  Commission  shall  promote  and  sponsor  the

column1: training of technical personnel on the subjects of securities
markets, finance, law, money economics and other subjects
and for this purpose, the Commission shall be authorised to
defray the costs of study, in Sri Lanka or abroad of the officers
and servants of the Commission who are of proven merit as
determined by the Commission.
